item.subject: science
item.stem: Priya's mother mixes a spoonful of curd into two bowls of milk. Bowl 1 has warm milk; bowl 2 has milk straight from the refrigerator. After five hours, only bowl 1 has set into firm curd. What is the best reason for this difference?

options.A: The bacteria in the starter grow and multiply faster at warm temperatures, so they turn the milk into curd quickly.
options.B: Cold milk contains fewer nutrients, so the bacteria in the starter cannot use it.
options.C: Warmth kills all the harmful microorganisms in the milk, allowing curd to form.
options.D: The refrigerator adds extra water to the milk, which stops curd from setting.
